tables.name: job.actor
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW actor AS (
 SELECT ap.actor_id,
    ap.type,
    ap.active,
    ar.role
   FROM (job.actor_projection ap
     LEFT JOIN job.actor_role_assignment ar USING (actor_id))
)

indexes.name: actor_projection_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX actor_projection_pkey ON job.actor_projection USING btree (actor_id)

triggers.name: actor_projection_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER actor_projection_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON job.actor_projection FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION job.update_updated_at_column()

constraints.name: fk_role
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (role) REFERENCES job.actor_role(role) ON UPDATE CASCADE

tables.name: job.execution_claim_detail
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW execution_claim_detail AS (
 SELECT e.execution_id,
    e.job_id,
    e.job_revision_id,
    e.attempt,
    e.lease_token,
    e.lease_expires_at,
    r.type AS job_type,
    r.config AS job_config,
    e.created_at
   FROM (job.execution e
     JOIN job.job_revision r ON (((e.job_id = r.job_id) AND (e.job_revision_id = r.revision_id))))
)

tables.name: job.execution_detail
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW execution_detail AS (
 SELECT e.execution_id,
    e.job_id,
    j.owner_id AS job_owner_id,
    e.job_revision_id,
    e.trigger_type,
    e.status AS current_status,
    e.attempt,
    e.lease_token,
    e.lease_expires_at,
    e.next_run_at,
    e.result,
    e.created_at,
    e.updated_at,
    r.type AS job_type,
    r.config AS job_config,
    r.retry_max_attempts AS job_retry_max_attempts,
    r.retry_backoff_type AS job_retry_backoff_type,
    r.retry_initial_delay_ms AS job_retry_initial_delay_ms,
    r.retry_max_delay_ms AS job_retry_max_delay_ms
   FROM ((job.execution e
     JOIN job.job_revision r ON (((e.job_id = r.job_id) AND (e.job_revision_id = r.revision_id))))
     JOIN job.job j ON ((e.job_id = j.job_id)))
)

tables.name: job.job_detail
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW job_detail AS (
 SELECT j.job_id,
    j.owner_id,
    j.enabled,
    j.name,
    j.created_at,
    j.updated_at,
    r.type,
    r.config,
    r.retry_max_attempts,
    r.retry_backoff_type,
    r.retry_initial_delay_ms,
    r.retry_max_delay_ms
   FROM ((job.job j
     JOIN job.job_current_revision cr ON ((j.job_id = cr.job_id)))
     JOIN job.job_revision r ON (((cr.job_id = r.job_id) AND (cr.revision_id = r.revision_id))))
)
